title: Linear buckling maturity extension
policy: This candidate contract defines the evidence required for 0.2.6 requalification. It does not close G08 or upgrade historical evidence.

scope.formulation: first tangent-instability factor from a converged proportional preload
scope.assembly: existing Total-Lagrangian solid assembly with initial-stress geometric tangent
eigensolvers: scipy.sparse.linalg.eigs fallback for indefinite shift-invert brackets
scope.claim_boundary: bounded linearized tangent buckling only; no universal stability or physical-validation claim

dependencies.rationale: G08 requalifies an existing linear buckling route. G07 geometric-nonlinear review is not silently treated as a prerequisite or as evidence for G08.

requirements.metric: accepted/rejected element family, material, load and boundary-condition combinations

threshold.value: TET4|TET10|HEX8|HEX20; one homogeneous family; isotropic_3d; nodal dead loads

requirements.evidence: case result, structured diagnostic and exact input configuration

requirements.phenomenon: Preload equilibrium and initial-stress geometric stiffness
requirements.metric: preload residual, constrained initial tangent, geometric tangent decomposition and finite critical factor

threshold.source: TOL-026-NONLINEAR-001 and existing preload diagnostics; no new numeric value approved here

requirements.evidence: preload history, residuals, tangent metadata and determinant/mesh diagnostics when applicable

requirements.phenomenon: Critical factor against an analytical or controlled reference
requirements.metric: case-defined relative error of the first critical factor and reported bracket width

threshold.source: TOL-026-ANALYTICAL-001 is case-defined; no G08 band exists

requirements.evidence: reference derivation, units, geometry, boundary conditions, factor, error and digest

requirements.metric: relative eigenpair residual, finite mode norm and deterministic sign convention

threshold.source: No G08-specific mode-residual band is currently controlled

requirements.evidence: mode vector, norm, residual, free-DOF mapping and solver diagnostics

requirements.metric: critical-factor sequence, successive changes, mode tracking and mesh-quality metadata

threshold.source: Existing TOL-026-ANALYTICAL-001 is case-defined; the minimum level count is not Owner-approved here

requirements.evidence: coarse/medium/fine/refined definitions when applicable, DOF, factors, changes, quality and limitation

requirements.metric: mode norm, deterministic sign, repeated-run equality and mode identity where the route exposes one mode

threshold.source: The route exposes the first mode only; no multi-mode orthogonality policy is currently controlled

requirements.evidence: mode metadata, repeat digests and configuration

requirements.metric: invalid inputs and numerical failures are rejected with structured reasons and never reported as PASS
requirements.evidence: failure category, message, diagnostics and input provenance

requirements.metric: critical factor and mode comparison over the declared comparable scope

threshold.source: Oracle-specific; unavailable or non-comparable tools must be SKIPPED with justification

oracle: CalculiX when the solid deck is comparable
Code_Aster only where an equivalent modelisation exists
requirements.evidence: deck, solver/version, model mapping, factors, modes, differences, skips and digest

requirements.metric: exact source SHA, dirty state, environment, command, thresholds and artifact digests
requirements.evidence: machine-readable manifest linked to every executed G08 case and aggregate report

failure_modes.diagnostic: missing, zero or invalid preload configuration/load
constrained initial tangent is not positive definite
shift is singular or no residual-qualified in-bracket eigenpair is recovered
route currently returns the first mode only
unconstrained rigid mode prevents positive-definite initial tangent
mesh validation rejects geometry before solve

threshold_governance.rule: No proposed or null policy may be converted into a numerical pass band by the runner.

gate_boundary.gate_closure: not permitted by this contract alone
gate_boundary.historical_evidence: 0.2.5 evidence remains historical/bounded and must be replayed or explicitly accepted under the 0.2.6 contract
excluded: shell/beam/discrete buckling through this solid route
